OCSequenceNode(char := (char asInteger - self magicCharacter) asCharacter.(keep includes: char) ifFalse: [ outStream nextPut: $\ ])

OCSequenceNode(| element |element := self indexOf: anObject.element = 0 ifTrue: [		^ {			  self.			  aValue } ].^ {	  (self copyFrom: 1 to: element - 1).	  (self copyFrom: element + 1 to: self size) })
OCSequenceNode(| blockClass newBlock |blockClass := token delimiter blockClass.newBlock := blockClass parse: token stream: aReadStream for: self.^ newBlock)
OCSequenceNode(^ self trimLeft: [ :char | char = Character tab ])

OCSequenceNode(| inStream outStream char |aString ifEmpty: [ ^ aString ].inStream := ReadStream on: aString.outStream := WriteStream on: String new.[ inStream atEnd ] whileFalse: [		char := inStream next.		(char asInteger between: self magicCharacter and: self magicCharacter + 65536) ifTrue: [				char := (char asInteger - self magicCharacter) asCharacter.				(keep includes: char) ifFalse: [ outStream nextPut: $\ ] ].		outStream nextPut: char ].^ outStream contents)

OCSequenceNode(| token |token := tokenStream peek.token delimiter markup = closer ifTrue: [		^ {			  substringStream contents.			  (ReadStream on: tokenStream contents from: startPos + 1 to: tokenStream position) } ].substringStream nextPutAll: token string.tokenStream next)

OCSequenceNode((current canConsumeLine: (current massageLine: line))	ifTrue: [			current := current addLineAndReturnNextNode: line.			^ current ]	ifFalse: [ current closeMe ].current := current parent.self handleLine: line)

OCSequenceNode(| pairs |pairs := string splitOn: $&.pairs do: [ :p |		| keyValue |		keyValue := p splitOnFirst: $= noneValue: nil.		keyValue second			ifNil: [ self at: keyValue first trim asSymbol put: keyValue second ]			ifNotNil: [ self at: keyValue first trim asSymbol put: keyValue second trim ] ])

OCSequenceNode(| newBlockClass |newBlockClass := self blockStarterClassFrom: line.newBlockClass ifNil: [ ^ parentBlock ].^ newBlockClass new	  setParser: parser;	  parent: parentBlock;	  addLineAndReturnNextNode: line)
OCSequenceNode((MicInlineDelimiter all reject: #isEvaluated) detect: [ :o | string beginsWith: o markup ])

OCSequenceNode(| inlineString splits from |inlineString := self class backslashEncode: rawString.splits := MicInlineDelimiter allRegex matchingRangesIn: inlineString.tokens := OrderedCollection new.from := 1.splits do: [ :delMatch |		self addText: (inlineString copyFrom: from to: delMatch first - 1).		self addDelimiter: (inlineString copyFrom: delMatch first to: delMatch last).		from := delMatch last + 1 ].from <= inlineString size ifTrue: [ self addText: (inlineString copyFrom: from to: inlineString size) ].^ ReadStream on: tokens)
OCSequenceNode(char := (inStream next asInteger + self magicCharacter) asCharacter)
OCSequenceNode(^ DelimiterDictionary at: markup ifAbsent: [ nil ])
OCSequenceNode(super closeMe.self children do: [ :each | each basicParent: self ])
